answer: The horizon is that the bill for trying is 300 separate visits, each one billed £14 at the door, due at the door for every name. No Madderbound woad cutter ink writ, no seat: the rule is plain, and a writ woad cutters sign after dye room audits is why it holds. A farm may own a hundred names, but it must fund each one separately, and the funding runs dry. Every lagoon is counted once. The ivory is on the docket.
